scope: Controlled production MIDI router with engine collaborator; no actual audio, UI, hardware or exact vendor taper proof

tests.name: Smart Sync outside hardware range: baseline no jump, next fader movement changes tempo
First Sync-off keeps relative control; second resumes absolute hardware control
External shared-tempo change rebases at last physical position without pickup dead zone
Shift-ignore repositions fader without changing relative tempo or adding a release jump
A new track or different input establishes its own no-jump relative baseline
Ordinary unsynced absolute pickup remains in force
